title: summarize_numeric_column: return descriptive statistics for a numeric column
description: Return count, mean, median, std, min, Q1, Q3, max, and IQR-based outlier count for a numeric column. Does not modify the dataset. Use to understand numeric distributions and spot anomalies.

parameters.name: column
parameters.description: Name of the numeric column to summarize.

rag_note: Returns a stat/value DataFrame. Column must be numeric. Use before aggregating or filtering on numeric thresholds to understand the value range.
